\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Two Point Contraction}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.RandomVariables.Sharp.TwoPointContraction
\section{Overview}
The biased two-point inequalities hold for arbitrary real values and have explicit extremizers. They give both forward contraction and the optimal radius bound, uniformly over two-point laws with a minimum atom mass.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Biased two-point inequality for real values]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.biased_two_point_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.bias_coefficient_pos_lt_one, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.nonnegative_biased_two_point_le}
\difficulty{4}
Let $1<p<2$, $0<\alpha<\beta$, $\alpha^p+\beta^p=1$, and $u,v\in\bbr$. Put $r=(\alpha^p\beta^{2-p}-\alpha^{2-p}\beta^p)/(\alpha^2-\beta^2)$. Then $(\alpha^pu+\beta^pv)^2+r\alpha^p\beta^p(u-v)^2\le(\alpha^p|u|^p+\beta^p|v|^p)^{2/p}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Sharp weighted two-point contraction]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.weighted_biased_two_point_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.bias_coefficient_eq_radius_sq, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.biased_two_point_le, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.sharpDiscreteRadius}
\difficulty{4}
Let $1<p<2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $u,v\in\bbr$. Setting $\rho=\rho_*(p/(p-1),\lambda)$, one has $(\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v)^2+\rho^2\lambda(1-\lambda)(u-v)^2\le(\lambda|u|^p+(1-\lambda)|v|^p)^{2/p}$. Here $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(\ell/q)/\sinh(\ell/(q/(q-1)))}$ with $\ell=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[An extremizer for the biased inequality]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.biased_two_point_extremizer}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $1<p<2$, $0<\alpha<\beta$, and $\alpha^p+\beta^p=1$. Put $r=(\alpha^p\beta^{2-p}-\alpha^{2-p}\beta^p)/(\alpha^2-\beta^2)$. For $u=\beta/\alpha$ and $v=\alpha/\beta$, one has $u\ne v$, $\alpha^pu^p+\beta^pv^p=1$, and $(\alpha^pu+\beta^pv)^2+r\alpha^p\beta^p(u-v)^2=1$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Necessary radius for weighted contraction]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.weighted_biased_radius_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.bias_coefficient_eq_radius_sq, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.biased_two_point_extremizer, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.sharpDiscreteRadius}
\difficulty{5}
Let $1<p<2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $\rho\ge0$. If $(\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v)^2+\rho^2\lambda(1-\lambda)(u-v)^2\le(\lambda|u|^p+(1-\lambda)|v|^p)^{2/p}$ for every $u,v\in\bbr$, then $\rho\le\rho_*(p/(p-1),\lambda)$. Here $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(\ell/q)/\sinh(\ell/(q/(q-1)))}$ with $\ell=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Forward weighted two-point contraction]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.weighted_biased_forward_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.finite_noise_duality, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.weighted_biased_two_point_le, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.sharpDiscreteRadius}
\difficulty{5}
Let $q>2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $u,v\in\bbr$. Put $\rho=\rho_*(q,\lambda)$ and $m=\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v$. Then $(\lambda|\rho u+(1-\rho)m|^q+(1-\lambda)|\rho v+(1-\rho)m|^q)^{2/q}\le\lambda u^2+(1-\lambda)v^2$. Here $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(\ell/q)/\sinh(\ell/(q/(q-1)))}$ with $\ell=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Two-point contraction from an atom bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.weighted_two_point_le_of_atom_bound}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.radius_mono_bias, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.radius_pos_lt_one, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.radius_sq_le_balanced, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.SharpDiscrete.weighted_biased_two_point_le, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.sharpDiscreteRadius, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.two_point_ineq}
\difficulty{6}
Let $q>2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, $\lambda\le\gamma\le1-\lambda$, and $u,v\in\bbr$. Put $p=q/(q-1)$ and $\rho=\rho_*(q,\lambda)$. Then $(\gamma u+(1-\gamma)v)^2+\rho^2\gamma(1-\gamma)(u-v)^2\le(\gamma|u|^p+(1-\gamma)|v|^p)^{2/p}$. Here $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(\ell/q)/\sinh(\ell/(q/(q-1)))}$ with $\ell=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
\end{theorem}
